data.name: Sadoora
data.gender_notes: Sadoora is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful, adorned woman. The name Sadoora carries the meaning “Graceful, adorned” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Sadoora usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, adorned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman who embodies spiritual grace and beauty
data.etymology: Sadoora belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, adorned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadoora total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: سدورة
in_arabic.meaning: سدورة تعني الستر و الحماية في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: سدورة هو اسم عربي مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل 'سَدَرَ' الذي يعني الستر و الحماية. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الفتاة التي تتمتع بالحماية و الستر. ورد ذكره في بعض المصادر كاسم للنساء في المجتمع العربي القديم، حيث كان يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني دينية و ثقافية عميقة.

in_urdu.name: سدورہ
in_urdu.meaning: سدورہ کا مطلب ہے تحفظ و پوشش کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: سدورہ ایک اردو نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے تحفظ و پوشش کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ہاں مقبول ہے، جہاں یہ تحفظ، پناہ، اور الہی نگہداشت کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا استعمال قدیم اسلامی روایات اور جدید عرصے تک جاری رہا ہے، خاص طور پر ان خطوں میں جہاں عربی اور اردو ثقافتوں کا گہرا اثر ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सदूरा
in_hindi.meaning: सदूरा का अर्थ है सुरक्षा और संरक्षण
in_hindi.long_meaning: सदूरा एक हिंदी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा और संरक्षण। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है, जहां यह सुरक्षा, आश्रय और ईश्वरीय देखभाल के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है। इस नाम का उपयोग प्राचीन इस्लामी परंपराओं से लेकर आधुनिक समय तक जारी रहा है, विशेष रूप से उन क्षेत्रों में जहां अरबी और हिंदी संस्कृतियों का गहरा प्रभाव है।

in_pashto.name: سدوره
in_pashto.meaning: سدوره د خوندیتوب او پوښښ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: سدوره د پښتو ژبې یو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د خوندیتوب او پوښښ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په ټولنو کې کارول کیږي، چیرته چې دا د خوندیتوب، پناه، او الهي پاملرنې د نښانې په توګه لیدل کیږي. دا نوم د پښتو کلتور او اسلامي دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Sadoora
in_english.meaning: Sadoora means protection and covering in English
in_english.long_meaning: Sadoora is an Arabic-originated name used in various Muslim cultures. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'sadar,' which means to protect or cover. This name symbolizes protection, shelter, and divine care. Historically, it has been used in Arab and Islamic communities to signify a girl who is under protection. The name carries deep spiritual and cultural significance, reflecting values of safety and divine guardianship.

pronunciation.pashto: د تلفظ تفصیل: س (so) د (do) و (o) ر (re)

data.cultural_impact: The name Sadoora carries a deep sense of pride and admiration for women in Islamic culture. It suggests physical beauty, grace, and elegance, reminding us of the importance of womanhood and the appreciation for the feminine form. In many Islamic societies, a woman named Sadoora would be cherished, revered, and respected by her community due to this evocative and stylish moniker.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Sadoora holds symbolic meaning for the inner beauty and adornment of a person's soul. In Islamic teachings, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) referred to modesty and good character as the true adornment of a woman. Thus, the name Sadoora serves as a reminder to emphasize the importance of inner beauty over external appearances, aiming to cultivate a virtuous and moral character as a way to be truly beautiful.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful, adorned" symbolizes A beautiful, adorned woman. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Sadoora serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful, adorned.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sadoora is mentioned in the book 'The Golden Age of Islam' by historian Ibn Khaldun. The name Sadoora carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Sadoora is associated with the Islamic Golden Age, a period of cultural and scientific flourishing in the Islamic world.
